verdict.rationale: Deel offers webhooks for real-time event notifications (deel-docs-6, deel-docs-7) which can trigger downstream automation, and its MCP server/API allows agents to invoke actions like creating contracts or time-off requests. However, there is no evidence of a built-in rules engine where users can define conditional trigger-action logic natively within Deel — automation still requires external glue code (e.g., a webhook consumer plus API calls). missing for 10: native if-this-then-that rule builder, conditional logic/branching support, evidence of built-in automated action execution tied to rules rather than just webhook delivery and API/MCP tool invocation.
